text.converter: vic_convert2.py (stdlib zipfile + ElementTree over word/document.xml; kept outside the repository), from 2026-11-07; the text first deposited on 2026-11-06 was made by vic_convert.py
text.conversion: The Word file was converted to UTF-8 plain text by Legalese Commons (vic_convert.py: stdlib zipfile and ElementTree over word/document.xml). The table of provisions, running heads and footers are dropped; the cover is kept as the file prints it (twice). Each provision starts on its own line with its number; paragraphs are indented two spaces a level; the register's marginal history notes are kept as "[Side note: ...]" lines before the provision they annotate; tables are "| a | b |" rows; Word equations are linearised in place. The endnotes (amendment history) are kept. Nothing else is changed.
known_conversion_artefacts: the cover (version number, title, number, version date) appears twice at the head, as in the Word file
the "Note" and "Example" labels stand on their own line, unindented, before their text
multi-line formulas set as indented paragraphs keep their brackets but lose their alignment

reconverted_2026_11_07.converter: vic_convert2.py, the same converter as vic_convert.py with one fix: Word <w:sym> characters with a code of F000 or more are kept
reconverted_2026_11_07.why: vic_convert.py dropped every <w:sym> character with a code of F000 or more. The register sets some characters that way in the Symbol font: F0D7 is its raised decimal point, F0B4 the multiplication sign, F02D the minus sign, F0B7 a bullet (and Wingdings boxes). In this Act the losses were the decimal point of the s 79(1) formula and the bullets of the notes to Part 1 of Schedule 3.
reconverted_2026_11_07.what_changed: 4 lines of the body, and only the restored characters (7 characters added: one "·" and three "•" each with its space): the formula in s 79(1) of the Victorian Act (required deposit amount into the Public Purpose Fund), which read "07 (A + B)" and now reads "0·7 (A + B)" (line 710), so the factor is 0.7, not 7; and the three bullets of the Notes at the head of Part 1 of Schedule 3 (provisions applying in relation to non-participating jurisdictions, lines 6739-6741). No other number, formula or operative word changed. Line numbers are unchanged. The notice header is unchanged. Checked by a diff of the old text against the new.
reconverted_2026_11_07.encodings_affected: none: the baseline-2026-11 encoding (legal costs, from the client's seat) encodes neither s 79 nor Schedule 3; only its recorded text hash was updated
